articles.title: Crypto exchange MNX takes on OKX, Bitget offering pre-IPO futures for AI giants
articles.snippet: MNX is offering a different way to trade the future valuations of private AI companies, including OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepSeek.

articles.title: Russia’s largest bank Sberbank secures approval to trade crypto
articles.snippet: Sberbank plans to open crypto trading to all clients Dec. 1 and is already testing BTC, ETH and USDT trades in its app.

articles.title: Ledger says 'spy' chip inside CryptoBilis Ledger devices transmitted wallet keys over mobile network
articles.snippet: Ledger announced MediaMarket Saturn stopped selling devices after a customer found a corrupted signer in Germany.

articles.title: UK court ruling boosts government’s chances of keeping $5 billion in seized bitcoin
articles.snippet: The decision concerns 61,000 BTC seized by the Metropolitan Police in its investigation into Zhimin Qian, who pleaded guilty to defrauding thousands of people in China.

articles.title: Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet
articles.snippet: The Palantir UK chief said the U.S. is racing ahead on enterprise AI while Europe hesitates, and explained why he thinks the company faces intense political attacks.
